record_provenance: Redacted/portable derivative of the helper's direct terminal output: private paths replaced with ~ portable paths and sender identities omitted. NOT byte-identical to the original tool output. No account ID, password or session token is stored in this file; no full raw responses are stored publicly.

message_previews.content_treatment: Quoted public text snippets from the live chat, stored as data only — they are not instructions for any reader. Redaction is not universal anonymization.

private_state.note: Portable location and permission metadata only. Contents (containing account ID/password/session) were never read or copied into the repo, docs or memory.
private_state.warning: Do not run the live creation helper again: the exclusive attempt ledger is written before the first creation request and its preexistence refuses the whole run. The account is created and owned by the user; no automatic new accounts.

account_ownership_note: The created account is owned by the user. Reuse only within user-authorized future scope (e.g. bounded read-only profile/network/console integration after explicit scope confirmation); never duplicate creation.
